description: Submit the signed-in user's draft time entries for startDate through endDate (one to seven work dates, YYYY-MM-DD) to their approvers. Each draft is submitted or refused with its reason (running_timer, unpriced, narrative_required, time_period_locked, invalid_entry; wrong_status or not_found when it changed during the call), and the rest still move. The conditions are checked again by the write itself, so a draft edited meanwhile is refused rather than submitted. A submitted entry is read-only to its timekeeper until an approver approves it or returns it to draft. Pass approve: true to approve in the same step every draft the user is the approver of (a solo practitioner); the others are submitted.

approve.description: Approve the drafts the user is the approver of instead of submitting them

endDate.description: Last work date in YYYY-MM-DD format, at most six days after startDate

startDate.description: First work date in YYYY-MM-DD format
